context: Asuka lectures on learning through experience.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; connectives (を通じて/通じ/並ん/後半/含ま) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人は、経験を通じて成長します。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本を通じても、学べますか?
lines.en: Can we learn through books too?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、読書を通じて、視野が広がります。
lines.en: Yes, through reading, your horizons widen.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 授業の後半は、何を学びますか?
lines.en: What do we study in the second half of class?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 後半は、実例を含めて考えます。
lines.en: In the second half, we think, including examples.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本が、棚に並んでいますね。
lines.en: Books are lined up on the shelf.
lines.style: observant adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 並んだ本を通じて、世界とつながります。
lines.en: Through the lined-up books, we connect to the world.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 経験を通じて、学び続けたいです。
lines.en: I want to keep learning through experience.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
